values.note: Sites 1-30 are open year-round, with limited facilities from November through March (the booking site: bathhouse closed November 1 - May 1, portable toilets only); sites 31-65 are open April 1 - October 31. The park's main page instead gives the campground season as April 28 - October 31.

season.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/blackwater-falls-state-park/lodging/camping-at-blackwater-falls/ (Campground Seasons & Dates) + https://book.wvstateparks.com/ecomm/listings/supplierdetail/7816932/en-US/?supplierid=11067324 (Other Policy: bathhouse closed November 1 - May 1) + https://wvstateparks.com/parks/blackwater-falls-state-park/ ('Campground Season And Dates April 28 – October 31'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Book online at book.wvstateparks.com at any time, by phone (1-833-WV-PARKS) or at the campground office. Weekend reservations are for no less than Friday and Saturday together; one night is fine Sunday-Thursday. Full payment at booking; cancellations 60+ days out refundable, later ones as park credit.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/blackwater-falls-state-park/lodging/camping-at-blackwater-falls/ ('Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Fri., Sat.) or one night during the week'; 'Visitors may book a maximum of 14 consecutive nights') + booking site policies, read 2026-10-20

values.note: One central bathhouse with hot showers, a laundromat and a dump station; the bathhouse closes November 1 - May 1.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/blackwater-falls-state-park/lodging/camping-at-blackwater-falls/ ('a centrally-located bathhouse with hot showers, a laundromat and a dumping station'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 65 tent and trailer sites, all with electric hookups.

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/blackwater-falls-state-park/lodging/camping-at-blackwater-falls/ ('65 total tent and trailer sites'; 'All campsites include electric hookups'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed the inherited WV booking terms for this park (2-night weekend minimum, 14-night max, book.wvstateparks.com). Added season (sites 1-30 year-round, 31-65 Apr 1-Oct 31; the park's main page says Apr 28-Oct 31, both in the note), showers/laundry/dump, 65 sites all electric. Fees not re-quoted (the booking page shows no rate without a live date search; the $49.99 from 2026-10-12 stands). Not stated: electric amperage, water/sewer, max rig length.
